Now I'll view one reference image from Anthracnose to confirm.

The test image shows a green mango leaf with multiple dark brown/black, irregular, sunken-looking spots scattered across the surface. This matches the Anthracnose description precisely: "oval or irregular brown to deep brown sunken spots on leaves" and "irregular, oval-shaped spots all over the leaf surface."

- **Sooty_Mould**: ruled out — no continuous black sooty coating
- **Powdery_Mildew**: ruled out — no white powdery residue
- **Die_Back**: ruled out — leaf is green and not wilting/curling
- **Anthracnose**: matches — discrete dark irregular sunken spots on a green leaf
